LESSON: WRITING LETTER SOUNDS (F-J)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.2: Writing letter sounds (f-j)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing letter sounds (f-j), part of Writing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How are we supposed to write on different surfaces?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing letter sounds (f-j) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: Originality as the learner colours and paints letter sounds f-j while singing related rhymes.

● Creativity and imagination: Making observation as the learner observes the teacher write letter sounds f-j one by one while

facing the same direction and model them

Values:
● Responsibility is developed as the learner tries upon self to perfect model, paint and write letter sounds.

● Peace is enhanced as the learner interacts with others to work together harmoniously.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Personal hygiene awareness is created as the learner becomes aware of the need to wash hands after a modelling activity.

Link to other Learning Areas: Creative activities as learners join dots to form sounds.

Suggested learning resources: Board , books, charts, board, digital device or cards of letter sound
